context: Hi, how are you today?
Great, you?
I'm doing very well. What kind of movies do you like to watch?
I like horror, thrillers, and foreign movies. Seen any good ones?
I got a perfect one that hits all three. Have you seen Parasite?
No I haven't yet but I will if you recommend it!

It's amazing. It just won Academy Awards for Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Foreign Film. It's about a Korean family that tricks a rich family into hiring them and then tries to take over their house.
Sounds good, I will see it once it comes out on DVD! Thanks for the recommendation
Have you seen any foreign films that you really like? What do you like about them?
I like how the plot lines are different than Hollywood. My favorite is Hero, what about you?
Hero is a gorgeous film! Stellar directing. In that same vein, I think Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon is my favorite 'martial arts' movie.
I love martial arts films! I would love to see Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon, I accept your recommendation
Oh good! I'll send along the movie trailer in a minute. What do you like about martial arts films?
Thank you, I would love to watch a trailer for it! I like how martial arts movies have fighting scenes as well as good plots

Well I think Crouching Tiger is a perfect film for you. It won four Oscars, including Best Foreign Language Film, and its screenplay was also nominated. What's your favorite martial arts film fight scene?
Wow I didn't know it won that many oscars. My favorite fight scene is probably the village fight scene at the beginning of Journey to the West. How bout you?
There's a 2019 film called Shadow that has a fantastic scene where people fight with bladed umbrellas. It's a beautifully choreographed, white-knuckle scene.
I have never heard of it, what's it about?

It's hard to completely summarize, but I think Google does a good job: 'To finally achieve victory over a rival kingdom, a brilliant general devises an intricate plan involving his wife, a look-alike and two kings.' I don't have access to the trailer, but I can send you the Crouching Tiger one if you'd like.
Thanks for the recommendation, please send the Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon if you have it!
entity: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (Wo hu cang long) (2000)
